_note: Ukrainian; see topbar.json and docs/translating.md. The inspector at the right of the Edit view: its tabs (Фігура, Текст, Поява for Shape, Text, Build), the theme slide and stage layout panels, the fields, menus, buttons and hover texts. Labels sit in narrow rows, so they are kept short (Шрифт, Розмір, Колір, Контур, Тінь, Кут, Зсув, Розмиття); Opacity is Непрозорість, as image editors say it (100% is solid). A text box is поле, any other box рамка; margins are відступи, so they never meet поле. Font weights follow the usual Ukrainian type names (Тонкий … Чорний). A build's sides are nouns (Лівий бік, Верх) because the same words follow both Звідки and Куди.
